catalyst_observation.source_statement: FDA CRL for tenapanor (CKD-on-dialysis phosphorus control) received 2021-07-28, publicly announced by the issuer 2021-07-29. The 8-K states the FDA agreed the data were 'effective' but characterized the treatment-effect magnitude as 'small and of unclear clinical significance,' requiring an additional trial - an efficacy-magnitude rejection with 'no safety, clinical pharmacology/biopharmaceutics, chemistry, manufacturing, and controls or non-clinical issues identified,' i.e. a genuine NDA rejection, not a CMC-only or mixed disclosure.
